content.value_statement: Generative artwork can be hard to reproduce and control. This skill guides seeded p5.js sketches with concepts, parameters, and export options.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of self-contained p5.js HTML art artifacts.
Defines a two-phase workflow for concept and implementation.
Uses seeded randomness patterns for repeatable visual results.
Provides examples for noise fields, particle systems, and parameter sliders.
Includes download patterns for PNG and optional SVG export.
limitations: It is guidance, not a packaged art renderer.
The default template loads p5.js from a public CDN.
Complex generated sketches may need performance tuning.
Accessibility and responsive behavior still need final review.

use_cases.title: Prototype Generative Sketches
use_cases.description: Create reproducible p5.js artwork concepts with seeds, controls, and export behavior.

use_cases.title: Teach Creative Coding
use_cases.description: Explain seeded randomness, noise fields, and particle systems through practical visual examples.

use_cases.title: Build Interactive Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Produce browser-based visual experiments for product demos, presentations, and design studies.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Sketch
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple seeded artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple p5.js generative artwork with seeded randomness. Include a concept, sidebar controls, and PNG download.

prompt_templates.title: Noise Field Study
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore responsive controls and visual texture.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an interactive noise-field artwork in p5.js. Use a fixed seed, adjustable complexity, color controls, and responsive canvas behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Particle System
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a particle-system artwork in p5.js. Include seeded initialization, flow-field motion, reset controls, and export options for presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Art Artifact
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete algorithmic art artifact. Include a manifesto, custom parameters, reproducible seeds, accessible controls, and performance notes.

output_examples.input: Create a calm geometric meditation artwork with seed controls.
output_examples.output: A one-page p5.js artifact with a geometric concept, seed navigation, sliders, and PNG download.

output_examples.input: Make a particle artwork inspired by river currents.
output: A flow-field composition using particle motion.
Controls for density, speed, and color behavior.
A repeatable seed system for regenerating the same image.

output_examples.input: Design an interactive procedural background for a demo.
output_examples.output: A responsive canvas sketch with adjustable parameters and a concise design rationale.

best_practices: Use explicit seeds so each artwork can be reproduced.
Test generated controls and exports in a browser before sharing.
Use local or integrity-checked assets for strict security needs.
anti_patterns: Relying on unseeded randomness when results must be repeatable.
Sharing generated HTML without reviewing external scripts or accessibility.
Adding many particles or sliders without checking browser performance.

faq.question: Does this skill create executable files?
faq.answer: It guides generation of self-contained HTML artifacts. Review generated files before sharing or running them.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: The provided template loads p5.js from a CDN unless changed to a local copy.

faq.question: Can I reproduce the same artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill emphasizes fixed seeds for repeatable results.

faq.question: Can users change the visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. The algorithm, parameters, controls, and color systems are intended to be customized.

faq.question: Can it export images?
faq.answer: The examples include PNG download and optional SVG export patterns.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
